findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：前十大客戶占營收 44%（FY2025 40%、FY2024 41%），公司自述這些客戶有多家供應商可選；搜尋摘要稱無單一客戶占營收逾 10%。未查到特定最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的公開報導。
findings.excerpt: For 2026, 2025, and 2024, 44%, 40% and 41%, respectively, of our total revenue came from sales to our top ten customers. These customers have a variety of suppliers to choose from and therefore can make substantial demands on us

customer_second_source.note: 兩次搜尋未見客戶第二供應商／in-house 的具名事件；快照稱 10-K 載明無單一客戶>10% 營收，未逐字核對。
